purpose: Let installed or locally available AI assistants improve SEIS AI through supervised review, synthetic training-case proposals, deterministic seed-model rebuilds, and promotion-gate evidence without live credential use or unsupported foundation-model claims.
truthBoundary: Repository-local training control plane only. It performs no live provider calls, no credential validation, no SSH, no deployment, no external dataset download, no cloud fine-tuning, and no claim that SEIS owns a trained foundation model.

trainingMeaning.currentMeaning: Training means adding or reviewing SEIS-owned synthetic cases, rebuilding local deterministic seed-model artifacts, running benchmark and promotion gates, and recording evidence.

notes: The command checks route readiness only.
No provider prompt, repository upload, credential read, or live model verification was performed.
Missing key status means the current shell did not expose that provider credential.

safetyRules: No secrets, .env values, private keys, cookies, or tokens may enter training prompts, datasets, logs, reports, or browser storage.
No browser code may receive provider credentials or unrestricted provider base URLs.
No cloud fine-tuning, external dataset download, paid benchmark, SSH, deployment, push, or merge may run without explicit human approval.
Installed AI output is untrusted candidate material until Codex validates it against repository evidence.
All accepted training cases must be SEIS-owned synthetic examples with no user-private data.
Core SEIS remains zero-key and Local Demo capable even when every live provider is unavailable.
Fallback identity must stay truthful; non-Anthropic output must not be called Claude output.
Seed models keep runtime authority false until independent benchmark, observability, rollback, and security gates pass.
